name: Malik (zealot)
backstory: Zealot Malik is a True Soul zealot of the Cult of the Absolute in Act Two. He is stationed at the stairs leading into Moonrise Towers, guarding the entrance from intruders and vetting any new arrival before they can enter the seat of the Absolute.
